title: Retina Initial Instructions
description: Initial routing decisions and cautions for grading this examination (1000-series and 5000-series).
purpose:
The diagnostic report will include the inital routing decision the photographer made when capturing the images, 
as well as any cautions that should be considered by the graders when performing the grading of the examination.
